cues.en: Mike: In the past two videos you learned about the Spearman correlation and you learned about the Fisher Z-transformation.
cues.zh: Mike：前兩支影片學到了史皮爾曼相關與費雪 Z 轉換。

cues.en: Now both of these concepts are fairly straightforward to implement in code, and so I thought I would combine them both into the same code video.
cues.zh: 這兩個概念都相當容易用程式碼實作，所以我想把它們合併在同一支程式影片。

cues.en: So here we are.
cues.zh: 就是這裡。

cues.en: I'm gonna start by giving you all of the data for Anscobe's B'S quartet, which I've already shown you, I think now twice in the videos.
cues.zh: 首先提供安斯康姆四重奏的全部資料，我想前面影片已經展示過兩次了。

cues.en: So here you have series one, these are the X and Y coordinates, series two for the X and Y coordinates and so on for the four series.
cues.zh: 這裡是第一組的 X 與 Y 座標，第二組的 X 與 Y 座標，四組依此類推。

cues.en: And then it looks like there's a whole lot of plotting going on here, but it's actually not so bad.
cues.zh: 這裡看起來有很多繪圖程式碼，但其實還好。

cues.en: Mostly we are just plotting the data and then the rest of this stuff is just making it look a little bit nicer, drawing a least squares line between them.
cues.zh: 大部分只是畫資料，其餘是讓圖更好看，例如在資料中畫一條最小平方法擬合線。

cues.en: And then here's the main thing I wanna show you.
cues.zh: 這是主要想展示的部分。

cues.en: This is the core function to compute the correlation coefficient between this variable and this variable.
cues.zh: 用 corr 函式計算這個變數與這個變數的相關係數。

cues.en: Now this you already know, I've already shown you this code before.
cues.zh: 這你已經知道，之前展示過這段程式碼。

cues.en: The main difference here is that now I'm adding an extras pair of inputs.
cues.zh: 主要差別是，現在多加了一對輸入。

cues.en: So I have type P, of course the P is for Pearson.
cues.zh: 這裡有 type P，P 當然代表 Pearson。

cues.en: So then I have this line here for core S.
cues.zh: 這一行則是 corr S。

cues.en: And now this line is almost exactly the same as the previous one.
cues.zh: 它與上一行幾乎完全相同。

cues.en: The only difference is that it is type S for Spearman correlation.
cues.zh: 唯一差別是 type S，代表史皮爾曼相關。

cues.en: So, and that shows you how to compute a Spearman correlation using the MATLAB core function.
cues.zh: 這就是如何使用 MATLAB 的 corr 函式，計算史皮爾曼相關。

cues.en: As I mentioned in, I guess it was two videos ago, you can also compute the Spearman correlation by first rank transforming your data
cues.zh: 大概兩支影片之前提過，也可以先把資料轉成秩，

cues.en: and then computing the Pearson correlation.
cues.zh: 再計算皮爾森相關，得到史皮爾曼相關。

cues.en: But you know that's a little bit more work than what you really need to do.
cues.zh: 但那比真正必要的工作多了一點。

cues.en: So you can actually just use the type S input in the core function.
cues.zh: 所以直接在 corr 函式中使用 type S 輸入即可。

cues.en: So then this just reproduces the graph that I showed in the slides.
cues.zh: 這就重現了投影片中展示的圖。

cues.en: And then the other thing I want to show you here is the Fisher Z-transform.
cues.zh: 另外要示範的是費雪 Z 轉換。

cues.en: So here I'm simulating correlation coefficients.
cues.zh: 這裡模擬相關係數。

cues.en: Now in this case, don't actually need data, we just need the R values.
cues.zh: 這次不需要真正的資料，只需要 r 值。

cues.en: So I'm generating these R values as uniformly distributed random numbers.
cues.zh: 所以用均勻分布的隨機數產生 r 值。

cues.en: So these are numbers that vary between zero and one, and then I multiply by two.
cues.zh: 數字介於 0 到 1，再乘以 2。

cues.en: So it varies between zero and two.
cues.zh: 就變成 0 到 2。

cues.en: And then I subtract one.
cues.zh: 接著減 1。

cues.en: So now it varies between minus one and plus one.
cues.zh: 現在就介於負 1 到正 1。

cues.en: And that is the range of correlation coefficients.
cues.zh: 這就是相關係數的範圍。

cues.en: Here I compute the isher Z-transform, as I mentioned in the slides, you can just compute this as the arc, the inverse hyperbolic tangent
cues.zh: 這裡計算費雪 Z 轉換。投影片中提過，可以直接計算反雙曲正切，

cues.en: or the arc hyperbolic tangent.
cues.zh: 也就是 arc hyperbolic tangent。

cues.en: Okay, so the function is atanh, and then I'm going to make some plots.
cues.zh: 函式是 atanh，接著畫一些圖。

cues.en: So this is a visualization of the distribution of the raw correlation coefficients and their Fisher Z-transformed values.
cues.zh: 這裡視覺化原始相關係數，以及它們的費雪 Z 轉換值的分布。

cues.en: And then in figure three, we have also a figure that you saw in the slides and a benefit here is we can zoom in.
cues.zh: 第三張圖也是投影片中看過的圖，不過這裡有個優點，就是能放大。

cues.en: So I'm gonna zoom into the Y axis here just to restrict the range of the Y axis a little bit.
cues.zh: 我要沿 Y 軸放大，稍微限制一下 Y 軸範圍。

cues.en: So here the Y axis goes from, you know, minus five and a half to plus five and a half.
cues.zh: 這裡 Y 軸從大約負 5.5 到正 5.5。

cues.en: And now I'm zooming in so that we have a value of minus 0.8 to plus 0.8.
cues.zh: 現在放大到負 0.8 到正 0.8。

cues.en: And I just wanna do this to show you that the Fisher Z and the correlation, the raw correlation, are really similar to each other over a pretty respectable range.
cues.zh: 只是要示範，費雪 Z 與原始相關，在相當大的一段範圍內非常相似。

cues.en: You know, we could zoom in further, but you know, somewhere around like maybe 0.5ish, correlation of round 0.5, that's when they start diverging
cues.zh: 還可以繼續放大，但大概在 0.5 左右，也就是相關約 0.5 時，兩者才開始

cues.en: in a little bit more of an obvious way.
cues.zh: 比較明顯地分開。

cues.en: But certainly for modest to small correlation values, the Fisher Z-transform and the correlation, the raw correlation are almost exactly the same values.
cues.zh: 不過，對中等到較小的相關值而言，費雪 Z 轉換與原始相關，幾乎完全相同。

cues.en: Okay, so I'm going to start here by giving you all the data to produce Anscobe's quartet.
cues.zh: 這裡先提供產生安斯康姆四重奏的全部資料。

cues.en: This is that example that I've shown now twice already.
cues.zh: 這個例子之前已經展示兩次。

cues.en: That illustrates the effect of outliers on the correlation coefficient and the difference between Pearson and Spearman correlations.
cues.zh: 它示範離群值對相關係數的影響，以及皮爾森與史皮爾曼相關的差異。

cues.en: So here we have data series one, these are the X coordinates and the Y coordinates.
cues.zh: 這是第一組資料，包含 X 座標與 Y 座標。

cues.en: And for series two, the X coordinates and the Y coordinates and so on.
cues.zh: 這是第二組的 X 座標與 Y 座標，依此類推。

cues.en: And then doing a lot of plotting here.
cues.zh: 接著有很多繪圖程式碼。

cues.en: But mostly I just want to draw your attention to these two lines here.
cues.zh: 不過主要想請你注意這兩行。

cues.en: This is where I compute the Pearson R.
cues.zh: 這裡計算皮爾森 r。

cues.en: So the Pearson correlation coefficient, and this is where I compute the Spearman R.
cues.zh: 也就是皮爾森相關係數；這裡計算史皮爾曼 r。

cues.en: So the Spearman correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 也就是史皮爾曼相關係數。

cues.en: So it's pretty easy to compute the Pearson or the Spearman.
cues.zh: 計算皮爾森或史皮爾曼都很容易。

cues.en: As I mentioned in, I guess it was two videos ago, you could actually compute the Spearman correlation by first rank transforming the data and then computing the Pearson correlation
cues.zh: 大概兩支影片之前提過，也可以先把資料轉成秩，再對那些秩轉換後的資料，

cues.en: on those ranked transform data.
cues.zh: 計算皮爾森相關，得到史皮爾曼相關。

cues.en: But you know, if you want to do that, then go for it.
cues.zh: 想這樣做當然可以。

cues.en: But it's of course simpler just to use the function Spearman.
cues.zh: 但直接使用 spearmanr 函式，當然比較簡單。

cues.en: Okay, so here we see that plot.
cues.zh: 這裡可以看到圖。

cues.en: And you know, this basically just reproduces what I showed you in the slides, except now I see there's a tiny bug here.
cues.zh: 基本上就是重現投影片中的內容，不過現在發現這裡有個小錯誤。

cues.en: So there that looks better.
cues.zh: 這樣就好多了。

cues.en: Now we have the Spearman correlation here of 0.99.
cues.zh: 現在這裡的史皮爾曼相關是 0.99。

cues.en: So it's hardly affected by this outlier, whereas the Pearson is underestimating this relationship because of this outlier.
cues.zh: 幾乎不受這個離群值影響；皮爾森則因為這個離群值，低估了這個關係。

cues.en: Okay, so then I wanna show you the Fisher Z-transformation.
cues.zh: 接著示範費雪 Z 轉換。

cues.en: So I'm generating 10,000 numbers that are, you know, these aren't really correlation coefficients, but they're numbers that have the same range
cues.zh: 產生 10,000 個數字；它們其實不是真的相關係數，只是與相關係數具有相同

cues.en: as correlation coefficients.
cues.zh: 範圍的數字。

cues.en: So I generate uniform distributed numbers between zero and one, and then I multiply them by two.
cues.zh: 先產生 0 到 1 之間的均勻隨機數，再乘以 2。

cues.en: And that gives me uniform numbers between zero and two.
cues.zh: 得到 0 到 2 之間的均勻隨機數。

cues.en: And then I subtract one to get numbers between minus one and plus one.
cues.zh: 接著減 1，得到負 1 到正 1 的數字。

cues.en: And then the Fisher Z-transformation can be simplified by computing the inverse hyperbolic tangent, which is given by the function arctanh.
cues.zh: 費雪 Z 轉換可以簡化成計算反雙曲正切，對應的函式是 arctanh。

cues.en: And then we just input the correlation values.
cues.zh: 直接輸入相關值。

cues.en: So let's see, then we can see a histogram.
cues.zh: 接著可以看直方圖。

cues.en: So this is a histogram of the correlation values for orange and the Fisher Z for blue.
cues.zh: 橘色是相關值的直方圖，藍色是費雪 Z。

cues.en: And you see that the correlation value are bound between minus one and plus one and the Fisher Z are kind of normally distributed.
cues.zh: 可以看到，相關值受限於負 1 到正 1，而費雪 Z 有點像常態分布。

cues.en: All right, and then the last plot that I wanna show here is a plot that I showed in the slide.
cues.zh: 最後要示範的圖，是投影片中展示過的。

cues.en: So this is just showing you point by point the correlation coefficient and the Fisher Z-transform.
cues.zh: 逐點顯示相關係數與費雪 Z 轉換。

cues.en: Now I mentioned in the slides that for relatively, you know, modest to small correlation values, these two, the Fisher Z and the original correlation
cues.zh: 投影片提過，對相對中等到較小的相關值，費雪 Z 與原始相關這兩者，

cues.en: are really, really similar.
cues.zh: 非常非常相似。

cues.en: And they start to diverge only when you get to the boundary.
cues.zh: 只有接近邊界時才開始分開。

cues.en: So for correlations close to minus one and close to plus one.
cues.zh: 也就是相關接近負 1 或正 1。

cues.en: So we can visualize that a little bit better by zooming into the Y axis here.
cues.zh: 可以沿 Y 軸放大，讓視覺呈現更清楚。

cues.en: So I'm gonna zoom into the Y axis goes from minus 0.8 to 0.8.
cues.zh: 我要把 Y 軸放大到負 0.8 至 0.8。

cues.en: So this is in the range of modest to pretty strong correlations.
cues.zh: 這涵蓋從中等到相當強的相關範圍。

cues.en: And here you see even more strikingly, it's even more clear that the raw correlations and the Fisher Z are are really, really similar and they start to diverge noticeably, maybe
cues.zh: 這裡更加清楚看到，原始相關與費雪 Z 非常非常相似，可能到相關

cues.en: around correlation of 0.6, around here.
cues.zh: 大約 0.6，也就是這附近，才開始明顯分開。
